title: Incomelec
description: incomelec.com Incomelec is a Colombian company founded in 2006 in Bogota, the Latin American leader in pedestrian, vehicle and passenger access control including turnstiles and automated barriers. With 52 employees and operations in 14 countries, it has installed equipment in over 20 airports, 90 parking facilities and 250 buildings, handling more than 85 percent of Colombia's toll booth systems. Its flagship product is BIOMIG, an automated migration control system used at El Dorado and Medellin airports with iris scanning and passport verification. It is the exclusive regional partner of Automatic Systems from the Bollore Group and the only distributor worldwide that locally assembles TR-490 and TR-491 turnstile lines. Led by CEO Kris De Sutter Gomez, it serves Metro de Medellin, TransMilenio and BD Bacata, Colombia's tallest building.
